Our Vision

A Connected RPAS Innovation Ecosystem

To establish a connected RPAS innovation ecosystem that accelerates technology adoption, strengthens Canadian industry capabilities, creates high-value employment opportunities, and positions Alberta as a centre for emerging autonomous technologies. The Hub connects industry, emerging technologies, entrepreneurs, and talent to unlock new opportunities.

Four Strategic Pillars

The RPAS Innovation Hub

An industry-driven ecosystem designed to accelerate the adoption, application, and commercialization of remotely piloted and autonomous systems across Canada.

Pillar 01

RPAS Services & Industry Solutions

Advancing innovative RPAS applications and industry-driven solutions that improve productivity, operational efficiency, and business capabilities.

Pillar 02

Autonomous Delivery & Logistics

Exploring next-generation autonomous mobility, intelligent logistics, and emerging delivery solutions that transform how businesses and communities connect.

Pillar 03

Workforce Innovation & Development

Building future-ready talent pipelines through competency development, industry engagement, and emerging career pathways — including the AACP™ one-week RPAS Workforce Hub program.

Pillar 04

RPAS Technology & Advanced Manufacturing

Fostering opportunities in RPAS technology development, systems integration, advanced manufacturing, and industry-led innovation.

How to Join

Your Path into the RPAS Workforce Hub

Cohort spaces are limited. Acceptance is based on AACP™ review of your expression of interest — typically within 5 business days.

01

Submit your expression of interest

Tell us about your background, experience and interest in the RPAS Workforce Hub. There are no formal prerequisites.

02

AACP™ reviews your application

We review your background and interest and respond within 5 business days. We look for genuine curiosity about RPAS career opportunities — no prior experience required.

03

Confirm your place and fee

Individuals whose expressions of interest are accepted will receive next-step instructions, including payment arrangements. Your place is confirmed once the $1,200 CAD program fee has been received.

04

Complete the RPAS Workforce Hub

Career intelligence, applied RPAS learning and industry context — delivered over one structured week.

Express Your Interest

Ready to Explore Drone-Enabled Career Opportunities?

Complete the RPAS Workforce Hub expression of interest form. Our team will review your submission and be in touch about next steps.

The RPAS Workforce Hub is open to adults 18+ who are curious about how RPAS capability can support or create career opportunities. No prior drone experience is required.

RPAS ACIA™ is Distinct

The RPAS Workforce Hub uses a dedicated RPAS ACIA™ experience — separate from the General ACIA™ Career Intelligence Assessment — designed specifically for the RPAS workforce context.
